wiki_text: Costa Azul's Export Terminal Phase 1 shipped its first LNG export cargo on July 8, 2026, marking the start of commercial operations after construction reached 94% completion in mid-2025. The milestone comes amid a broader ramp-up of Waha-basin feedgas supply into the Sempra/TotalEnergies-owned Baja California facility.

Sempra Ships First ECA LNG Cargo, Eyes Commercial Start as Waha Natural Gas Firms

wiki_text: Sempra ended the Vista Pacifico LNG project in December 2025, after its non-binding development agreement with Mexico's CFE (extended through that month to allow further negotiation) was not renewed into a definitive gas-supply and development agreement. The project had been proposed since November 2020 for a site near Topolobampo, Sinaloa, with CFE, Sempra, and TotalEnergies as prospective co-developers.
